title: sse: fix partial-JSON delimiter ordering and token/event framing issues (openai-compat)
author: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: Fixes a class of SSE streaming bugs where partial-JSON payloads could be emitted with incorrect delimiter ordering or where token and event lines were delivered out of order, causing downstream clients (notably OpenAI-compat consumers and SDKs) to see malformed partial JSON. Root cause: a race between the chunker that groups tokens into SSE events and the framer that emits delimiter tokens for partial JSON objects when buffers were flushed concurrently. This manifested as misordered "JSON_DELIM" markers, duplicate delimiters, or token/event swaps under load. Changes: 1) sse_framer: introduce per-stream sequence numbers and strict emit ordering to guarantee token/event ordering across flush boundaries; 2) chunker: add a small deterministic buffering window and explicit delimiter placement for partial JSON tokens so that delimiters are always emitted before the following token/event; 3) openai_compat adapter: update framing logic to consume sequence numbers and tolerate partial JSON chunks that arrive in adjacent events; 4) SDK compatibility touches: small guard in sdk-js streaming handler to ignore stray empty delimiter events; 5) tests: add targeted unit tests, integration tests, and a new fuzzer to exercise delimiter edge cases. Performance: microbenching shows negligible impact (<1% latency increase at p99) while removing a class of correctness bugs. Testing and CI: added unit+integration tests and a fuzzer job. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce issue with integration test - [x] Add unit tests and fuzzer harness - [x] Update openai-compat adapter - [x] Update SDK consumer handling (non-breaking) - [x] Add docs note to streaming.md - [x] Run CI and verify green. Related: Linear ENG-3412 (sse partial json corruption), ENG-3490 (openai compat streaming failures).
commits: fix(sse): ensure delimiter ordering for partial JSON tokens (sequence-numbered emit)
fix(openai-compat): consume SSE seq numbers and tolerate adjacent partial chunks
test(sse): add integration test reproducing delimiter reordering
test(fuzzer): add sse delimiter fuzzer with deterministic seeds
docs(streaming): add framing guarantees and examples

release_notes: Fixes SSE streaming partial JSON delimiter and token/event ordering bugs that could produce malformed partial JSON for clients. Improves OpenAI compatibility framing and adds tests and a fuzzer. Backwards-compatible for existing SDKs; SDK guard added to ignore stray empty delimiter events.
